name: "Build Your Own" Omelet with Mozzarella, Bacon, Tomato, Mushrooms, Peas & Chives (Kid-Friendly)

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ lb white mushrooms
1 tomato
¼ small pkg chives

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, thinly slice mushrooms.
Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add mushrooms and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until tender, 4-5 minutes. Transfer mushrooms to a large plate.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tsp butter, unsalted
⅛ tsp garlic powder
⅛ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, place eggs, salt, and pepper in a medium bowl. Whisk to combine and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Small dice tomato. Add to the plate with the mushrooms. (Keep the omelet fillings separate as you add them to the plate.)
Chop chives into small pieces. Add to the plate.
Rinse peas under hot water (from the tap) to thaw. Pat peas dry with paper towels, then add to the plate along with cheese and bacon bits.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup frozen peas
1 cup mozzarella cheese, shredded
½ cup bacon bits

instructions.primary_message: Give everyone a small bowl and have fun filling each bowl with their favorite omelet fillings. (Aim for about a ½-cup of filling per omelet.)
To make each omelet, preheat a small skillet or omelet pan over medium-low heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add 2 teaspoons of butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add a generous ⅓-cup of eggs to the skillet and swirl to cover the bottom. As the eggs begin to set, use a spatula to pull the cooked eggs towards the center of the pan. Then tilt the pan, allowing uncooked egg to move to the edges. Cook until just set, pressing the eggs into a smooth layer on the bottom of the skillet.

Arrange selected fillings over one side of the omelet. Fold the omelet in half and continue to cook until filling is warmed through and cheese starts to melt, 1-2 minutes more. Transfer omelet to a plate and repeat with remaining butter, eggs, and selected omelet fillings.
Show off your omelet creation and enjoy!
